data.summary: This two‑week plan front‑loads the weak Unit 8 material while giving a rapid overview of the remaining units. Week 1 builds core concepts and introduces practice problems; Week 2 is dedicated to mixed review and timed free‑response practice to solidify knowledge before the exam.

weeks.focus: Master Unit 8 fundamentals and get a broad survey of all other units.
tasks: Watch the live Class 9100 recording and take detailed notes on 8.1 and 8.2.
Do 15 free‑response questions on acid‑base concepts (8.1‑8.2) and grade with the AP scoring guide.
Complete a set of 10 mixed‑topic multiple‑choice questions covering the listed topics from Units 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9.
Create a one‑page concept map linking acid‑base ideas to related concepts in thermochemistry, equilibrium, and kinetics.

weeks.focus: Mixed review and timed practice across all units.
tasks: Complete a 60‑minute full‑length AP Chemistry practice exam (focus on free‑response).
Review each answer, noting any recurring errors and revisiting the specific topic codes.
Do 20 targeted free‑response questions: 5 from each of Units 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9.
Summarize key formulas and concepts on a two‑page cheat sheet for final exam review.

data.final_week_advice: Use the timed practice to simulate exam conditions, then spend any remaining time reinforcing weak spots identified in the review. Keep a calm pacing strategy and trust the systematic problem‑solving skills you built in week 1.
